subject: Capacity certification: MAP and load windows for Datacorp close
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@datacorp.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@datacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP / capacity cert and final acceptance windows

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We discussed a mutual action plan to certify Redwood for our production inference before our Q4 procurement sign-off. Quick asks from our side so we can lock the internal timeline:

- We need a short benchmarking plan that shows latency (p50/p95/p99), TTFT for cold starts, and throughput at 1k/5k concurrent sessions.
- Access to a staging endpoint and a set of test accounts/keys (read-only) so our SREs can run the scripts.
- Two 2-hour load windows next week (Sept 28–29) during which we’ll run steady-state and spike tests.
- Deliverable: a one-page acceptance note we can attach to the procurement packet.

Can you confirm runway and whether Redwood can provide a pre-built load script? If you can also include a sample MAP doc we can review, that’ll speed approvals.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Platform Engineering, Datacorp
+1 (415) 555-0119

Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP / capacity cert and final acceptance windows

Samantha — great to see this moving. We can support the full plan and have a short MAP template ready. High level answers below, and I’ll loop in Aditya/Karthik on the logistics.

- Metrics: we’ll return p50/p95/p99 latency, TTFT (cold start 95th), sustained throughput curves, and concurrency acceptance thresholds. We’ll also include resource utilization (GPU duty) during runs.
- Test env & keys: we can provision a staging VPC endpoint and three test API keys (one for SRE, one for app load, one for telemetry). Keys will be scoped & time-limited.
- Load windows: Sept 28 (14:00–16:00 PT) and Sept 29 (10:00–12:00 PT) proposed. If those conflict we can shift.
- Deliverables: MAP_Datacorp_v2.docx (MAP + success criteria), ttft_latency_summary.csv (results), and a short acceptance paragraph.

Aditya/Karthik — can you confirm the timeline for keys + sample load script? We’ll need the staging endpoint and scripts by EOD Fri (Sept 24) so Datacorp can validate internally.

Action items:
- Vanessa: finalize MAP and acceptance criteria (today)
- Aditya: provision staging endpoint & keys (by Sep 24 EOD)
- Karthik: provide load script and runbook for SREs (by Sep 24 EOD)
- Datacorp: confirm load windows or propose alternates

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP / capacity cert and final acceptance windows

Vanessa / Samantha — provisioning update.

- Staging endpoint: https://staging.datacert.redwood.io (VPN + allowlist applied).
- Test keys: three keys issued, TTL 72h. Keys attached as metadata (we sent them to Samantha’s secure inbox).
- Load script: included load_script.yml that wraps our k6 harness and supports steady, poisson spike, and cold-start sampling. Comments in the script explain where to adjust concurrency and payload size.

Important notes for the runs:
- Cold TTFT: we’ll run 30 cold-start samples at beginning of each window; use separate session tokens to avoid KV cache reuse.
- Concurrency: for the 5k concurrent test we recommend a gradual ramp to target over 10 minutes to avoid transient overload.
- Telemetry: we’ll stream token-level latency and GPU util to the shared Drive link. Please ensure your telemetry collector is whitelisted.

I’ll be on call for both windows and can join the runbook channel: #dc-cap-cert (we’ll create on Slack).

- Aditya
Aditya Rao
Infrastructure SRE, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Samantha — quick note on the acceptance checklist so procurement can sign off next week. We aim to close the deal the week of Oct 4; to enable that, could Datacorp confirm these two items after runs:

1) Acceptance threshold: p95 latency <= 1200ms at 5k concurrent (steady-state) and TTFT 95th <= 2.5s for cold-start sample.
2) Signed acceptance paragraph (one short paragraph) attached to PO.

If Datacorp cannot meet those thresholds during the windows, we’ll document remediation steps and a follow-up mini-window within 3 business days.

Vanessa — can you include the acceptance paragraph template in the MAP? I’ve added the procurement HubSpot link to the related_links for visibility.

Thanks — Lauren

Subject: Re: MAP / capacity cert and final acceptance windows

Team — thanks, all. Quick post-run notes and next steps (we ran both windows today):

- Results (summary): p50=210ms, p95=880ms, p99=1.6s at 5k concurrent steady-state. TTFT 95th (cold samples) = 2.1s. GPU util averaged 62% during steady-state.
- Artifacts attached: ttft_latency_summary.csv (CSV export from our telemetry) and a short run log we kept.
- Outcome: Datacorp leadership is comfortable with thresholds. We’ll sign the procurement packet pending the acceptance paragraph.

Vanessa — please send the acceptance paragraph and final MAP doc we can attach. Also sharing feedback on the run script: the cold-start sampler worked well but please add a flag to randomize session IDs by default.

Thanks everyone for quick turn.

Best,
Samantha
